description: Get the company's default component for a slot - use this to read the current email footer before editing it. Returns not_found when no default is set, which means emails fall back to the footer Sequenzy generates from the company profile.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

slot.description: Default slot to read. Currently only `footer`.

name: get_default_email_component

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_default_email_component` MCP tool.

component.description: The default email component for the slot record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
